seen_animation: A black ice-cream-cone drawing is enlarged so far that it fills the frame: a large arched scoop across the top two thirds, a nearly horizontal line under it (the cone's top edge), and the two upper sides of the cone leaving the bottom edge of the frame; the cone's point is never visible. Across all 16 frames the black drawing stays in place with only a slight downward drift (frames 1-10) and a slight rise back (frames 11-16), plus small wobble of the dome's right side. All the action is in thin grey lines: in frames 1-4 a curved grey ribbon loops inside the dome and slides right and down; in frames 5-10 two near-vertical grey lines lean and travel left out of the dome; in frames 10-13 a small grey U shape appears at the top centre and stays there; in frames 14-16 the U stretches downward and to the right into a long loop that reaches the cone's top line at the right.
seen_film: A close-up of soft-serve ice cream being dispensed into a paper cup. In frames 1-4 the ribbon of soft serve coils around the cup from the top centre to the right and down. In frames 5-9 the stream continues from the top left, the coil fills the cup and the stream moves toward the upper-left edge and leaves. In frames 10-13 the end of a new stream (a rounded tip) appears at the top centre-right and holds there. In frames 14-16 that stream pushes down along the right side of the cup to the rim. The cup rim stays roughly fixed with a small camera drift.
named_subject: An ice cream cone (a scoop on top of a cone), used here as the cup and mound of soft serve.
evidence: e.png 1-8 vs f.png 1-8: the grey ribbon loops and slides right inside the dome as the soft-serve coil does in the film, but the black character does not move, it only drifts a few pixels down (g.png labels 1,4 high, 16,19 lowest, then 22-43 back up). e.png 9-26 vs f.png 9-26: the film's stream sweeps toward the upper left; in the animation two thin grey lines lean left while the black cone holds. e.png 27-35 vs f.png 27-35: a grey U appears at top centre, matching the new stream tip in the film at the same moment. e.png 36-44 vs f.png 36-44: the grey loop stretches down to the right rim as the film stream does. The timing and placement of the event match, but the event is performed entirely by single grey scenery lines; the black doodle character is a static frame around it. In every frame the cone is cropped so its point is off-frame (a.png 1-16), so the drawing in c.png is never seen whole.
primary_gap: The film's event (a ribbon of soft serve coiling into the cup and a second stream pushing down the right side) is carried by thin grey scenery strokes, while the black doodle character only holds still and is cropped so its cone point is never shown.
closes_when: The black doodle itself, drawn whole or at least with its cone tip in frame, visibly takes part in the action, for example its scoop outline swelling, coiling or being pushed in step with the grey stream in e.png 1-8 and 36-44, so a viewer reads the doodle as the thing being filled.
protect: The timing match with the film: the coil sliding right in frames 1-8, the stream leaving left in 9-26, the stream tip appearing at top centre at frame 27 and pushing down the right side by 44; the stable, jump-free black outline; the doodle's stroke habits (polygonal dome made of short straight segments, the scoop's right end stopping short of the cone line, slightly kinked cone top line).
identity_gap: The dome and cone top line match c.png's construction, but the drawing is scaled up until the cone's lower half and point are cut off by the frame, so it reads as a cup rim and mound rather than the complete cone doodle.
